files.file: Main page component with role-aware tab navigation (Submit, Approvals, Execution, History). Submit + History render for every authenticated user; Approvals gates on the `approvers` trade-group, Execution on `executors` (TRSB_LEDGER.008b A4 fix 2026-05-20 -- gates on trade-group membership from /api/general/trades/users/me, NOT firm identity). A stale initialTab pointing at an ungranted tab clamps to Submit.
Re-exports TradeSubmission type from API, defines UserRole union type (initiator|approver|executor|admin)
Form to submit new trade with file upload, securities table, and pre-trade attestations
Lists pending trades requiring approval; shows approve/reject modals
Lists approved trades ready to execute; shows execution confirmation modal
Lists completed and rejected trades with view mode toggle (My Submissions vs All Trades) and pagination
Card component displaying trade summary (fund, submission ID, status, dates, counts, action buttons)
Editable table for securities with ticker autocomplete, identifier fields, weights, trade instructions
Drag-drop file upload zone for Excel/CSV files; handles parse status feedback
Text input with inline ticker suggestions from cache; accepts suggestion via Tab or Right Arrow
Confirmation modal for approving a trade submission with fund and securities count
Confirmation modal for executing a trade; shows brokerage destination and securities count
Modal with textarea for entering rejection reason; confirms before submitting
Full trade details modal showing metadata, timeline, securities table, and attestations

React Query hooks for fetching submissions: getAllSubmissions, getPendingApprovals, getMySubmissions, getSubmissionsByStatus (15s-60s refetch). Plus useTradeUserMe (key ['trade-user-me'], 5min staleTime) -- fetches the caller's own trade-user record for role-aware tab gating.
State and action handlers for approve, reject, execute, and download; manages modals and loading state
Parses Excel (.xlsx) and CSV files; extracts fund, dates, comments, and securities data

page_structure.tab: Allow users to submit new trade orders via form or file upload. Components: FileUploadZone, ConsolidatedTradePanel (fund/dates/destination/securities), AttestationsCard, SubmitButtonRow. Integrates with submitTrade, searchIdentifierCache, batchSaveIdentifiers APIs.

Display pending trades requiring approval. Shows alert banner when trades present. Render TradeCards with approve/reject/view/download actions. Modals: ApproveModal, RejectModal, TradeDetailsModal. Uses usePendingApprovals hook with 15s refetch.

Display approved trades ready to execute. Shows success banner when trades present. Render TradeCards with execute/view/download actions. Modals: ExecuteModal, TradeDetailsModal. Uses useApprovedSubmissions hook with 20s refetch.

Display completed and rejected trades. Features view mode toggle (My Submissions vs All Trades), status filter (Complete/Rejected), and pagination (20 items per page). Shows TradeCards with view/download actions. Uses useMySubmissions, useCompletedSubmissions, useRejectedSubmissions hooks.

issues.issue: Call API (referenced in documentation but implemented - backend call in SubmitTab.tsx:83)

state_management.description: All data fetching and caching handled by React Query with automatic refetch intervals. Query keys defined in tradeSubmissionKeys object. Cache invalidated on mutation success via queryClient.invalidateQueries().

form_validation.rules: - Fund, weightsAsOf, tradesAsOf, destination required - At least one security with ticker required - All four attestations must be checked
form_validation.error_display: Inline error message in red banner

modal_system.modal: Confirmation before approving trade. Shows fund and securities count. Calls approveSubmission() and invalidates cache on success.
Requires rejection reason textarea (required field). Calls rejectSubmission(reason) and invalidates cache on success.
Confirmation before executing trade. Shows brokerage destination. Calls executeSubmission() and invalidates cache on success.
Full read-only trade details: metadata, timeline (submitted/approved/executed), securities table, attestations. Supports download Excel action.

file_parsing.structure: Row 0: [_, fund] Row 1: [_, weightsAsOf] Row 2: [_, tradesAsOf] Row 3: [_, tradeComments] Row 4: [_, otherComments] Row 6: Headers Row 7+: Securities [ticker, sedol, isin, figi, currentWeight, proposedWeight, deltaWeight, tradeInstruction, comments]
file_parsing.special_handling: Skips cash/CURNCY rows. Handles Excel serial dates and percentage/decimal weight formats.

authentication.required_for: All trade operations - submitter email/name, approver email/name, executor email/name
authentication.auth_check: TradeSubmission.tsx shows login message if not authenticated

page_inventory.notes: - All timestamps formatted in Eastern Time (ET) - Trade statuses: PENDING_APPROVAL -> APPROVED -> EXECUTED (or REJECTED at any stage). EXECUTED is the durable terminal success state (Andrew Q2 ruling 2026-05-18: COMPLETE retired). COMPLETE is no longer written by any FE path; it survives in the TradeSubmissionStatus union for READ tolerance only -- legacy COMPLETE rows still exist in the table (not migrated) and must render cleanly. The orphaned completeSubmission FE function was removed in TRSB_LEDGER.008b. - TradeCard component uses conditional rendering for action buttons based on status - FileUploadZone shows parse status feedback with success/error indicators - TickerAutocompleteInput supports Tab/RightArrow keyboard shortcuts to accept suggestions - All modals use Z_INDEX.modal for proper layering - File operations (download Excel) handled through downloadExcelFile API - Securities table has auto-calculate delta weight (proposed - current)
